content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Sparkling:

- **§ 2 (Grant of Licence, p0028):** the licence is expressly "non-transferable and **non-exclusive**" — no reciprocal sourcing commitment from us.
- **§ 3 (Restrictions on Use, p0029–p0037):** restrictions are confined to copying, assignment/sublicensing, reverse engineering, scope of authorized use and protecting the Work from third parties. There is no "shall purchase all of its requirements from", no bar on procuring competing software or third-party maintenance.
- **§ 10 (Maintenance and Support):** obligations run against Garman; nothing requires us to take support only from Garman.
- Document-wide searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "compete/competitor", "sole source" and prohibitory operators ("shall not", "may not", "agrees not to") surfaced only the non-exclusive licence grants (p0028, p0115), the exclusive-remedy clause (§ 15) and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0146) — none of which is an exclusive dealing covenant.

No redline proposed; we remain free to buy from other suppliers.
